title: Range
author: David Epstein
thesisParagraph: Early specialization works in narrow, rule-bound domains, but many important modern problems are ambiguous, changing, and feedback-poor. Breadth, sampling, analogy, and the willingness to pivot often produce better learning, innovation, judgment, and career fit than a fast head start down one track.

signatureMoves: turns management choices into resource-allocation and customer-demand puzzles
shows capable managers trapped by margins, incentives, and the wrong customers
uses jobs, disruption, and causal mechanisms before offering prescriptions
makes innovation theory answer to a concrete business decision
opens with vivid biographical or institutional scenes before naming the underlying research concept
avoidMoves: Avoid "The point is" as a paragraph hinge.
Avoid "the question is" as a setup crutch.
Avoid triadic abstract-noun lists such as clarity, courage, and resilience.
Do not make disruption a synonym for novelty.
Do not portray incumbent managers as fools when the trap is structural.
does not reduce the argument to generic anti-expertise slogans
does not rely on numbered self-help steps or workbook-style commands

voiceSpecimens: The crooked path can see patterns the straight path missed.
Sampling is not delay when the problem itself is still unnamed.
teachingArc: The opening movement separates kind domains from wicked ones, showing why the Tiger Woods template misleads outside golf, chess, and similar systems. The middle chapters turn breadth into learning mechanics: varied musical practice, desirable difficulty, analogical reasoning, quitting for match quality, and short-term experiments with possible selves. The final movement applies range to organizations, invention, forecasting, crisis decisions, and science, where outsiders, lateral recombination, active open-mindedness, and deliberate amateurism keep expertise from hardening into tunnel vision.
forbiddenMoves: Do not use startup gloss where the source is explaining causality.
Do not discuss innovation without the customer job or resource tradeoff.
